iconka-identity.title: Iconka Designs
iconka-identity.brief: I wanted an identity I could use across my design work, from a small signature on a graphic to a more prominent application.
iconka-identity.approach: The artwork pairs a restrained monogram with an expressive wordmark. I explored how the same identity looks on darker materials and an apparel graphic, keeping the maker recognisable without making every piece identical.
iconka-identity.note: I wanted people to recognise the maker without distracting from the design in front of them.
iconka-identity.effect: The three pieces show how one identity can work in quite different settings.

styled-couture.title: Styled Couture
styled-couture.brief: Bring a tailoring reference into a recognisable fashion mark.
styled-couture.approach: A thread-like emblem and the contrasting Styled and COUTURE lettering connect the identity to craft. Deep green and gold establish a consistent visual direction.
styled-couture.note: The thread detail helps the mark say something about the name without extra decoration.
styled-couture.effect: The finished mark brings its tailoring reference and the brand name into one composition.

nabis-diary.title: Nabi's Diary
nabis-diary.brief: Give a personal publication an identity and a way to celebrate its readers.
nabis-diary.approach: The ND letterform and soft violet setting establish the publication's mood. The brighter 70+ subscribers graphic gives a different moment a more celebratory feel.
nabis-diary.note: The identity could feel quiet while the milestone could celebrate the people reading.
nabis-diary.effect: The 70+ subscribers figure appears on the original milestone artwork; it is not presented as growth caused by the design.

food-maps.title: Food Maps
food-maps.brief: Explore a friendly identity around food and location.
food-maps.approach: Rounded lettering and a location-pin detail connect the name with finding food. A food-illustration pattern supports the mark.
food-maps.note: The location-pin detail connects the name to the idea of finding food.
food-maps.effect: The artwork presents a mark and supporting pattern; a public launch has not been verified.

kente-pa.title: Kente Pa Collections
kente-pa.brief: Show the fabric collection and make enquiry details easy to find.
kente-pa.approach: The fabric's colours and patterns carry the visual focus. Floral details frame two presentations, one worn by a model and one showing folded cloth, with contact information clearly placed.
kente-pa.note: The fabric needed to remain the focus; the other elements help organise the information.
kente-pa.effect: The artwork makes the product and enquiry details visible. Orders and reach figures have not been supplied.

fries-haven.title: Fries Haven
fries-haven.brief: Introduce the food business and help people find the menu, location and ordering details quickly.
fries-haven.approach: The launch graphic uses large lettering and a red-and-gold palette to catch attention. The menu is more practical, with prices and ordering details arranged for a quick read. Both pieces share a visual direction.
fries-haven.note: A food poster needs to catch attention, but the next question is often how much it costs and how to order.
fries-haven.effect: The two pieces show the offer, listed prices and contact route. Prices on the original artwork may no longer be current.

ldssa-colour-week.title: LDSSA Colour Week
ldssa-colour-week.brief: Present the Colour Week activities in a welcoming way while making the daily programme clear.
ldssa-colour-week.approach: Colourful lettering and lively shapes set the mood. In the schedules, the day-by-day details carry most of the information. The 2024 and 2025 designs take different visual directions while keeping that structure.
ldssa-colour-week.note: An event design needs to invite people in and help them understand where they need to be.
ldssa-colour-week.effect: The artwork shows a recurring event identity and practical information across two editions.

el-festin-elegante.title: El Festín Elegante
el-festin-elegante.brief: Introduce the dinner and awards event, then keep the information familiar as the date gets closer.
el-festin-elegante.approach: The main poster uses a dark palette, gold lettering and a clear information area. I carried that treatment into the five countdown designs, changing the day number while keeping the campaign recognisable.
el-festin-elegante.note: The countdown gave me a way to repeat the message without redesigning the whole poster each day.
el-festin-elegante.effect: The archive contains the event poster and five countdown designs; attendance information isn't available.

actex-learning.title: ACTEX Learning × ASSA-KNUST
actex-learning.brief: Help actuarial students see the topic, speakers and time of an examination-preparation session.
actex-learning.approach: The speaker information, examination topics and date each have their own space. The layout stays structured while colour helps the important details remain noticeable in a feed.
actex-learning.note: For an educational session, the audience should be able to spot the date and subject straight away.
actex-learning.effect: The poster communicates the event details. Registration or attendance figures were not supplied.

picnic-palooza.title: Picnic Palooza
picnic-palooza.brief: Create a picnic announcement that feels inviting while clearly listing the location and activities.
picnic-palooza.approach: Soft pink and green, a basket illustration and playful lettering build an outdoor feel. The activities sit in a separate band so the design stays lively while remaining useful.
picnic-palooza.note: I wanted the artwork to show the feel of the event and still answer the practical questions.
picnic-palooza.effect: The poster shows the planned activities and event details. Turnout has not been verified.
